text:
sarah: Heads-up: I pushed a tiny change to the kernel selector telemetry today. Need eyes on the log format before I flip the flag in prod.

anil: url to diff? :eyes:

sarah: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/+/r1234 - adds `pick_reason` and `pick_score` fields to the selector event, and a short human-reason string. Also emits `env_flags` snapshot.

max: Nice. Can you paste an example event here?

sarah: Sure — current debug sample from staging: 
```json
{
  "event":"kernel_select",
  "model":"redwood-v2-7b",
  "arch":"ampere",
  "seq_len":2048,
  "kv_cache_hit_ratio":0.12,
  "batch_size":8,
  "chosen_kernel":"attn_fused_b32",
  "pick_reason":"arch_match+high_seq_path",
  "pick_score":0.87,
  "env_flags":"REDWOOD_SELECTOR_DEBUG=1,REDWOOD_SELECTOR_DETAIL=trace"
}
```

eva: That pick_reason looks useful. Does the selector still produce low-level reason codes too? (like KERNEL_ARCH_PREF, SEQ_THRESHOLD, KV_CACHE_INFLUENCE)

sarah: Yes — the telemetry emits both a short string and a set of reason tags. The short string is meant to be human readable in logs. Tag set example: `["KERNEL_ARCH_PREF","HIGH_SEQ_PATH"]`. We decided to keep both to make dashboards + raw logs easy to query.

anil: How do we enable the detailed tracing? Any envs I should use for repro locally?

max: I added a quick runbook in the PR description. TL;DR: set `REDWOOD_SELECTOR_DEBUG=1` for event emission and `REDWOOD_SELECTOR_DETAIL=trace` to include decision path / score breakdown. For minimal noise `REDWOOD_SELECTOR_DEBUG=0` and `REDWOOD_SELECTOR_SAMPLER=0.01` will sample 1% of selections.

sarah: Command to enable locally: 
```
export REDWOOD_SELECTOR_DEBUG=1
export REDWOOD_SELECTOR_DETAIL=trace
./start-runtime --model redwood-v2-7b
```

eva: Good. Also, can the telemetry capture if batching heuristics changed the decision? I mean when a request is batched vs single-shot the selector might prefer a different kernel.

sarah: We added `batch_context` in the event: one of `single`, `auto_batch`, `manual_batch`. For auto batching we also emit `effective_batch_size` and a `batching_influence` score (0..1) that indicates how much the batched latency/cost tradeoff tilted the decision.

max: We had a regression last week where kv-cache warmups caused a different kernel to be selected and throughput dropped 9% — could this telemetry have caught that?

sarah: Yes, that's actually why I added `kv_cache_hit_ratio` and `kv_influence_tag`. In the regression traces we saw `kv_cache_hit_ratio` going from ~0.9 to ~0.1 after an upstream flush; selector flipped from `kv_optimized_attn` to `attn_fused_b32` which had worse throughput for our microbench. With the new logs you'll see both the ratio and a `kv_influence` number so you can correlate.

anil: Will the logs be big? Concerned about cost if we enable detail=trace in prod.

sarah: We emit full trace only when `REDWOOD_SELECTOR_DETAIL=trace`. By default `info` emits summary fields only. We also gate production with `REDWOOD_SELECTOR_SAMPLER` and platform-side retention rules.

max: For dashboarding, what fields should we aggregate? I'm thinking: count by `chosen_kernel`, avg `pick_score` by kernel, `kv_cache_hit_ratio` distribution, and `batching_influence` by route.

sarah: Exactly. Add additionally `pick_reason` top-k and a timeseries of `pick_score` percentiles. That surfaced the regression for us because `pick_score` dropped right before the throughput change.

eva: One more ask: can we include a tiny stack-ish trace for the decision path (not raw stack frames but the selector steps) so we can map back to code paths?

sarah: We added `decision_path` as a short list of step ids when detail=trace, e.g. `["arch_check","seq_len_bucket","kv_adjustment","batch_penalty"]`. Not huge, just enough to triage.

infra-bot: deploy: selector-telemetry v0.8 rolled to staging at 2026-04-12T15:02:10Z :rocket:

max: Awesome — I'll hook up a quick alert: if 95th pick_score < 0.5 and throughput drops >5% for a route then page.

sarah: Sounds good. I'll wait for a couple of thumbs-up before flipping sampling in prod.

anil: LGTM from infra side. :thumbsup:

eva: LGTM. I will add sample queries to the ops runbook.

max: Quick note for follow-ups: maybe include `hw_perf_counters` snapshot in trace mode for seq_len>1024 flows — might pinpoint micro-ops differences.

sarah: Noted. Will prototype a lightweight perf counter capture behind another flag so it doesn't blow up metrics.

max: Great work folks.

sarah: Thanks! merging later today unless anyone objects.
